mentions.name: DevExp (dx)
mentions.description: A developer-experience CLI that streamlines project setup: secrets stay local or sync across devices, tunnels with unlimited subdomains and WebSocket support, a full HTTP/WebSocket traffic inspector, per-project git profiles, and instant deploys to lightweight Deno isolates. Planned additions include an embedded database, password manager, dotfile manager, and boilerplate generator inside the CLI, with a waitlist at devexp.pro.
mentions.problem: Setting up new projects is a chore; DevExp aims to fix that.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Setting up new projects shouldn’t be a chore. We built DevExp (dx) to fix it.
-Secrets stay local (or sync across devices).
-Tunnels with unlimited subdomains + WebSocket support.
-Full HTTP/WebSocket traffic inspector.
-Git profiles per project — no more editing .gitconfig.
-Instant deploys to lightweight Deno isolates.
